title: 9 Local Marketing Strategies to Boost Your Brand Awareness

facts.fact: The page defines local marketing as a strategy that targets consumers and customers within a certain radius of a business's physical location(s).
facts.quote: Local marketing is a marketing strategy that targets consumers and customers within a certain radius of the physical location(s) of a business.

facts.fact: The page says local marketing is also known as neighborhood marketing or local store marketing.
facts.quote: Local marketing is also known as neighborhood marketing or local store marketing.

facts.fact: The article lists nine local marketing tactics for attracting new business from a local area and surrounding neighborhoods.
facts.quote: Here are 9 local marketing tactics that you can use to attract new business from your local area and surrounding neighborhoods.
